component.name: MirrorCam
component.summary: A minimal, borderless camera overlay for Linux

description.p: MirrorCam is a minimal, borderless camera overlay for Wayland, written in Rust with GTK4, libadwaita and GStreamer. It keeps a live camera preview on screen in a small floating window with auto-hiding panels.

ul.li: Borderless overlay with rounded corners, raised on click
Auto-hiding header bar with all the controls
Camera and resolution selectors with hot-plug support
Drag to move, drag the edges to resize

description.p: Initial release: borderless camera overlay with auto-hiding panels, camera/resolution selectors and a mirror toggle.
